# Tool contract (`amm-tools/3`)

<!-- GENERATED by docs/gen_tool_reference.py from amm.tools.contract(); do not edit by hand. -->

Schema version: `amm-tools/3`. Outcome schema: `amm-outcome/1`. 17 tools. Every tool is a method of `amm.tools.Session`; call it as `session.call(name, args)`, which validates the arguments (unknown keys are rejected), runs the tool, appends one record to `session.jsonl` (when the session has a directory) and returns `{ok, seq, state_hash, schema_version, result | error}`. The MCP server (`python -m amm.mcp_server`) exposes the same tools with the same descriptions.

The frozen copy of this contract is `results/software/contract_amm-tools-3.json` (`scripts/software/write_contract.py`); `python docs/gen_tool_reference.py` reports whether the live contract still equals it.

Profiles: **C** is the full system; **B** is the ablation arm of the benchmark (no `check_bounds`, no certificates, no as-built check). A tool marked *mutates* changes the specification and can be undone.

## Specification

### `set_material`

Set the solid material: a known name, or E_Pa, nu and rho_kg_m3 together. Its Poisson ratio enters every solve; E and density convert stiffness and frequency targets.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`; mutates the specification.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | "PA12" \| "Ti6Al4V" \| "316L" \| "AlSi10Mg" or null | `null` |  |
| `E_Pa` | float or null | `null` |  |
| `nu` | float or null | `null` |  |
| `rho_kg_m3` | float or null | `null` |  |

### `set_constraints`

Set the unit-cell size a (frequencies scale as 1/a) and the cell families allowed.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`; mutates the specification.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cell_size` | float or null | `null` |  |
| `cell_size_unit` | "mm" \| "cm" \| "m" \| "um" \| "in" | `"mm"` |  |
| `families` | list of "tpms" \| "struts" \| "resonator" or null | `null` |  |

### `set_target`

Set design targets (replaces only the keys given; clear=True starts from no targets). Stiffness in pressure units or "E_s"; density = solid fraction; E100 = Young's modulus along a cube axis; gap = a complete elastic-wave band gap covering [f_lo, f_hi] (all directions and polarizations).

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`; mutates the specification.

| `density_max` | float or null | `null` |  |
| `density_min` | float or null | `null` |  |
| `E100_min` | [Stiffness](#type-stiffness) or null | `null` |  |
| `E100_max` | [Stiffness](#type-stiffness) or null | `null` |  |
| `G_min` | [Stiffness](#type-stiffness) or null | `null` |  |

| `gap` | [Gap](#type-gap) or null | `null` |  |

## Checks and questions

### `check_bounds`

Rigorous physics bounds on the current targets (Voigt, Hashin-Shtrikman advisory, cubic stability, gap rules) and the family-atlas verdict: PROVEN_INFEASIBLE (a bound is violated, named), NOT_FOUND_IN_FAMILIES (no atlas cell can meet it even with the most favourable search-tier error), FEASIBLE (an atlas cell meets it with the least favourable error) or BORDERLINE. NOT_FOUND is not a proof of impossibility.

Profiles C; since `amm-tools/1`.

No arguments.

### `ask_clarification`

Ask the user one question with 2-5 options. The answer is returned; choosing an option does NOT change the spec, so apply it with set_material / set_constraints / set_target afterwards.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | str | required |  |
| `options` | list of [ClarifyOption](#type-clarifyoption) | required |  |

## Design (search tier)

### `list_families`

The cell families, their kinds, parameter boxes and validity rules.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`.

No arguments.

### `atlas_suggest`

The atlas cells (2,722 precomputed cells per material Poisson ratio, search tier) that come closest to the current targets, best first, with nominal and pessimistic slack (> 0 means met). Search-tier values, NOT certificates; costs no evaluations. Same in every profile (audit F07).

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `top` | int | `5` |  |

### `evaluate`

Search-tier properties of up to 16 designs (fast, about 1-2 s each; NOT certified, biased stiff and high in frequency by several %): density, E100, G, bulk, nu100 (normalized by E_s), complete band gaps (normalized f* = f a / c_t, and Hz when material and cell size are set), and the full homogenized tensor C (6x6 Voigt, order 11 22 33 23 13 12, engineering shear, normalized by E_s; C_MPa with a material) with derived quantities (cubic constants, Zener ratio, directional E100/E110/E111, Voigt-Reuss averages, eigenvalues).

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`; argument `bands` since `amm-tools/3`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `designs` | list of [Design](#type-design) | required |  |
| `bands` | bool | `false` | schema amm-tools/3: also return each design's search-tier band structure (`bands`: f* per k-point and band on the k-path G-X-M-G-R-X, with the k-points and labels; large, so off by default) |

### `search`

Bayesian optimization (BoTorch) over the family parameters for the current targets, seeded by the family atlas. Slack = relative distance to the nearest target (> 0 means met). objective "expected" uses search-tier values corrected by the calibrated median error; margin asks for slack > margin. Returns the 5 best designs with nominal / expected / pessimistic slack. Search-tier values, NOT certificates. Takes 1-15 minutes (wide gap targets take longest); tools run one call at a time, so wait for the result.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `budget` | int | `32` |  |
| `families` | list of "tpms" \| "struts" \| "resonator" or null | `null` |  |
| `objective` | "expected" \| "pess" \| "nominal" | `"expected"` |  |
| `margin` | float | `0.0` |  |

## Acceptance tier

### `certify`

Certificate of one design against the current targets (2-20 minutes; wait for the result): static properties by a three- resolution ladder with grid phases and a guarded error bound; complete band gap by inertia counts over the Brillouin zone at two resolutions with an edge-convergence guard; as-built offset +-0.01 a as a robustness flag. Verdict: certified / refuted / undetermined (inside the guard band: neither proven nor disproven). Only a certified design can be released.

Profiles C; since `amm-tools/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `design` | [Design](#type-design) | required |  |

### `as_built`

As-built robustness check of one design against the current targets (1-5 minutes; wait): the surface is eroded and dilated by `offset` (fraction of the cell edge a; 0.01 a = 0.1 mm on a 10 mm cell) and the static targets (densities excluded) and the gap counts are re-checked. The same check the certificate runs (certify.as_built_block): if this design was certified for the current targets in this session, its static rung and band index are used, and at the certificate's offset its result is returned without a new solve. A robustness flag, not a verdict and not required for release.

Profiles C; since `amm-tools/2`.
Result schemas: `result` = `amm-asbuilt/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `design` | [Design](#type-design) | required |  |
| `offset` | float | `0.01` |  |

## Manufacturing and export

### `screen_manufacturing`

Manufacturing SCREENING of one design (NOT a printability claim; 5-60 s, CPU): the estimated minimum solid feature and narrowest channel in mm against a printer limit (default: the material's typical minimum feature; or state printer_min_feature_mm), whether a tiles^3 block is one connected piece spanning x, y and z, and whether the exported surface is watertight. Needs the cell size for the feature check. Support, powder removal, residual stress and process parameters are not checked.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/2`.
Result schemas: `result` = `amm-screen/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `design` | [Design](#type-design) | required |  |
| `printer_min_feature_mm` | float or null | `null` |  |
| `tiles` | int | `3` |  |
| `resolution` | int | `64` |  |

### `export`

Export one design (10-60 s): a single-cell STL, a tiled STL (tiles^3 cells merged into one solid) and report.json with the full evidence (spec, design, outcome card, certificate summary if certified in this session, search-tier values incl. C* if evaluated, manufacturing screening, disclaimers), written to <session>/exports/<name>/. Lengths in mm when the cell size is set, else in cell units. The surface is the level set of the certified geometry model. Manufacturing screening only: NOT a printability claim.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/2`.
Result schemas: `result` = `amm-export/1`, `report.json` = `amm-export/1`, `screening` = `amm-screen/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `design` | [Design](#type-design) | required |  |
| `tiles` | int | `3` |  |
| `resolution` | int | `64` |  |
| `tile_resolution` | int | `32` |  |
| `printer_min_feature_mm` | float or null | `null` |  |

## Final answer

### `submit`

Final answer of the session: release one design, refuse the request (say why with `verdict`), or stop because information is missing. Profile C releases only a design certified in this session for the current targets, and refuses only with evidence held in this session for the current spec: verdict PROVEN_INFEASIBLE needs a check_bounds result with a violated bound; NOT_FOUND_IN_FAMILIES a check_bounds atlas verdict NOT_FOUND_IN_FAMILIES or a search over every declared family that found nothing; UNDETERMINED an undetermined certificate; OTHER any of these or a refuted certificate. `evidence`: the seq numbers of the records cited (default: every matching record held; get_session lists them). Returns the submission and its outcome card.

Profiles B, C; since `amm-tools/1`; mutates the specification.
Result schemas: `outcome_card` = `amm-outcome/1`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | "release" \| "refuse" \| "need_info" | required |  |
| `design` | [Design](#type-design) or null | `null` |  |
| `verdict` | "PROVEN_INFEASIBLE" \| "NOT_FOUND_IN_FAMILIES" \| "UNDETERMINED" \| "OTHER" or null | `null` |  |
| `note` | str | `""` |  |
| `evidence` | list of int or null | `null` |  |

## Argument types

### Type `ClarifyOption`



| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | str | yes | short answer text shown to the user |
| `set` | object |  | what choosing it sets, with the keys of the session state: material (name), cell_size ([value, unit]), gap_type ("complete"), or a target key (density_max, E100_min, G_min, bulk_min, nu100_min, nu100_max, gap) |

### Type `Design`

A cell design. Parameters by kind: TPMS {density, mode: sheet|network}; sc/bcc/octet {r, R} (strut radius, node-sphere radius, R = 0 or R >= r + 0.03); cube_bars {c, w}; sphere_ligaments {c, w}. Lengths in cell units.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "gyroid" \| "schwarz_p" \| "diamond" \| "iwp" \| "sc" \| "bcc" \| "octet" \| "cube_bars" \| "sphere_ligaments" | yes |  |
| `params` | dict of float or str | yes |  |

### Type `Gap`



| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `f_lo` | float | yes |  |
| `f_hi` | float | yes |  |
| `unit` | "Hz" \| "kHz" \| "MHz" \| "f*" | yes | "f*": normalized frequency f a / c_t |

### Type `Stiffness`



| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | float | yes |  |
| `unit` | "Pa" \| "kPa" \| "MPa" \| "GPa" \| "psi" \| "E_s" | yes | "E_s": fraction of the solid material's Young's modulus |

## Outcomes

| Outcome | Title | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `certified_candidate` | Certified candidate | every target accepted by the certificate (guarded static bounds, inertia-count gap, edge guard) |
| `refuted_candidate` | Refuted candidate | the certificate shows a target is violated beyond its guard band |
| `proven_infeasible` | Proven infeasible | a named rigorous bound (Voigt, cubic stability, gap rules) is violated |
| `not_found_in_families` | Not found in families | nothing found in a bounded search of the declared families; the atlas is an estimate with calibrated error ranges, not a bound |
| `numerically_undetermined` | Numerically undetermined | a claim lies inside the guard band: neither proven nor disproven at the certificate resolutions |
| `need_info` | Information needed | the request cannot be stated in solver units; the session stops and asks |

## Evidence records and the refusal rule

Applied in profile(s) C. `submit(decision="refuse", verdict=V)` must cite (or hold) an evidence record of one of these kinds for the current specification:

| Verdict | Accepted evidence kinds |
|---|---|
| `PROVEN_INFEASIBLE` | `bound_violation` |
| `NOT_FOUND_IN_FAMILIES` | `atlas_not_found`, `search_not_found` |
| `UNDETERMINED` | `certificate_undetermined` |
| `OTHER` | `bound_violation`, `atlas_not_found`, `search_not_found`, `certificate_undetermined`, `certificate_refuted` |

| Evidence kind | Supports outcome |
|---|---|
| `bound_violation` | `proven_infeasible` |
| `atlas_not_found` | `not_found_in_families` |
| `search_not_found` | `not_found_in_families` |
| `certificate_undetermined` | `numerically_undetermined` |
| `certificate_refuted` | `refuted_candidate` |
| `certificate_certified` | `certified_candidate` |

## Fields added in schema 2

Schema 2 only adds to schema 1; a version-1 log replays against the version-1 projection.

- `evaluate`: {"results": ["C", "derived", "C_MPa"]}
- `certify`: ["outcome"]
- `submit`: ["outcome_card", "submitted.outcome", "submitted.evidence"]
- `get_session`: ["schema_version", "evidence", "budget.as_built", "budget_used.as_built"]

## Added in schema 3

Schema 3 only adds the optional `bands` argument of `evaluate` (default false: the result is the schema-2 result) and, when it is true, a `bands` field per design (f* per k-point and band on the k-path, the k-points over pi, the path labels, `n_bloch`, `n_bands` and, with material and cell size, `hz_per_f_star`). A version-2 log replays in a version-2 session, which does not accept the argument.

- `evaluate`: {"args": ["bands"], "results": ["bands"]}
